Dear [Mr Bullock](/person/221),	
I would have offered to write [Fletcher](/person/1677)’s Life, but I have hunted all over the house twice over and cannot find the [book](/topic/213) I once had, but no doubt you can get it from a library[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd J.F.

Bullock/Radwinter Rectory/Saffron Walden.

Postmark Feb 24/94.
[^2]: CMY wrote several in a series of [\'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans\'](/book/358), which were intended to form part of Bullock\'s Daily Lections project, but were never published.
